# Blesscon Candy

> Blesscon Candy sells fruit candy, toffees, sour chews, energy candies, candy cones and gift packs online in Karachi and across Pakistan, by the box or carton. Contact: WhatsApp +92 341 3905030, blessconcandy@gmail.com. Prices in PKR. Last updated 15 November 2026.

## Key facts
- Products: RANI Fruit Candy (7 flavours), Fruity Galas Jumbo (9 flavours), Zoombie Sour Chew (5 flavours), Eclair Toffee, Big Butter Toffee with Almond, Kish jelly candy, energy candies (Red Bull, Sting, Monster, Booster), candy cones (Pan Masala, Sweet Eggs, Sweet Saunf, Mix Pan Masala), Rani Candy gift packs, custom Dholki favour cones.
- Prices start at Rs. 150 per box. RANI Fruit Candy: Rs. 5 per candy, Rs. 300 per box of 60, Rs. 7,200 per carton of 24 boxes.
- Karachi delivery is charged by zone (Rs. 250 to Rs. 1,450; over 40 km quoted). Minimum candy order in Karachi: Rs. 500 to Rs. 4,000 by area (Rs. 5,000 over 40 km).
- Rest of Pakistan: minimum order Rs. 10,000 (Sindh outside Karachi), Rs. 15,000 (Punjab, Islamabad, Balochistan), Rs. 20,000 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Azad Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan). Builty (freight) charges are shared by the team after the order is placed.
- Custom candy favours for weddings, dholki, mehndi and parties in Karachi.

## Karachi delivery zones (one-way distance: minimum order / delivery charge)
- Up to 5 km: Rs. 500 / Rs. 250. Areas: Godam Chowrangi, Mehran Town, Korangi (nearby sections), Qayyumabad
- Over 5 to 10 km: Rs. 1,000 / Rs. 450. Areas: Baloch Colony, Mehmoodabad, Manzoor Colony, Defence View, Akhtar Colony, DHA (nearby phases), Saddar
- Over 10 to 15 km: Rs. 1,500 / Rs. 600. Areas: Clifton, DHA (further phases), Bahadurabad, Tariq Road, Gulshan-e-Iqbal (nearby sections), Nazimabad, Landhi (parts)
- Over 15 to 20 km: Rs. 2,000 / Rs. 750. Areas: Gulistan-e-Johar, Malir, Shah Faisal, F.B. Area, North Nazimabad
- Over 20 to 30 km: Rs. 3,000 / Rs. 1,100. Areas: North Karachi, New Karachi, Orangi, Baldia, Scheme 33, Gulshan-e-Hadeed
- Over 30 to 40 km: Rs. 4,000 / Rs. 1,450. Areas: Surjani, Manghopir, Hawkes Bay, Other outlying location (30-40 km)
- Over 40 km: Rs. 5,000 / Quoted by our team. Areas: Bahria Town, DHA City, Other distant location (over 40 km)

## Rest of Pakistan minimum order

- Punjab, Islamabad Capital Territory, Balochistan: Rs. 15,000
